newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stock indices recover early losses by close.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stock indices recover early losses by close.

text.p: Madrid stock indices scrambled higher to recover earlier losses on Thursday boosted by Wall Street, bonds and strong gains seen in a small group of heavily weighted stocks, traders said.
The general index closed up 1.12 points, 0.25 percent, at 453.98, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares rose 9.93 points, 0.19 percent, to 5,231.43.
"Despite the rise in the indices we still saw some consolidation today as many stocks fell, with indices boosted by gains in a small group of dominant companies," one trader said.
Traders said turnover again reached record highs of 134.6 billion pesetas.
Traders said they expected a more subdued session on Friday ahead of the weekend and after a busy week.
Among individual stocks, Telefonica accounted for 43 percent of volume and by the close had slipped five pesetas to 3,275.
Repsol rose 100 pesetas after discounting an interim dividend of 79 pesetas paid on Thursday.
Among the electricity stocks, Endesa rose 260 pesetas to 9,500, while Iberdrola fell five pesetas to 1,700.
